digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler live verification against real Jira DC instance
propositions: A copy of this project's real ticket store (2673 tickets) must be isolated in a fresh git repo with no remotes and used to prove reconciliation works against realistic data, not an empty instance
The store copy must be scrubbed of all .bridge_state* binding artifacts and prev_snapshot.json to prevent phantom mutations and production Jira key references
28 comprehensive mutations (14 inbound + 14 outbound) must be individually asserted with specific oracles, covering creates/updates/deletes/links/parent-child/status/labels/assignee/comments
A local edit must provably reach DC (DC issue read-back confirms the change) and a DC-created issue must reach the local store after passes in both directions
Multi-page pagination must be validated by seeding 2*observed_page_size + 1 issues and confirming full recovery through the inbound fetch, not relying on store copy volume
